summary: Iter43-fix24az-d — Tested Garde rotation Saturday-noon toggle (Feature 1) and ContactGroupChips component (Feature 2). Backend logic + API: 13/13 PASS (8 unit + 5 HTTP). Frontend AdminGardePlanning rotation toggle: full UI flow validated (click → toast → persist across refresh → restore default). ContactGroupChips: code-reviewed and confirmed integrated into both WhatsAppModal & SmsModal with red ring border (ring-rose-500), role gating (admin/superviseur/moderateur), and 'lecture seule' fallback. UI click-test of the chips inside modals was limited by available trigger buttons on /portal/contacts (Messaging Center view) — see context notes.

issues: Welcome briefing modal intercepts pointer events on /admin/garde-planning when not yet dismissed — testing must remove it programmatically. Not a regression of this iter but a long-standing UX trap for fresh sessions.

action_items: (Optional) Add a /portal/contacts UI flow on the Messaging Center 'Tous' tab that exposes the WhatsApp/SMS send modal directly so test agents can validate the chips render via Playwright (currently the unknown-contacts cards only show Importer/Ignorer).
(Nit) The console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' on /admin/* pages is a pre-existing hydration warning unrelated to this iter — track separately.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactGroupChips.jsx is clean, well-scoped (~140 lines), uses optimistic UI + revert-on-error pattern, debounces via in-flight Set — good.
Role check uses lowercase set {admin,superviseur,moderateur} via TOGGLE_ROLES.has(role.toLowerCase()) — robust to case variations.
Backend route garde_planning.py exposes rotation_mode + next_rotation_at correctly; _next_rotation_iso handles both modes deterministically.
Settings validation in server.py:11910 rejects sunday_noon with proper HTTP 400 — verified live.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Feature 1f AdminGardePlanning); Feature 2b/2c chip-click validated by code review only

test_credentials: Admin: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (OTP via dev_otp). Auth bypassed for UI testing by injecting sawali_token + sawali_user into localStorage after API auth.
seed_data_creation: None — left existing DB untouched (per request). Did toggle settings.garde_rotation_mode during tests but restored to 'saturday_noon' (default) at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth on preview: POST /api/auth/login → returns dev_otp + session_token. Then POST /api/auth/verify-otp with {session_token, code:dev_otp} → returns {access_token, user}. To bypass login UI in Playwright: localStorage.setItem('sawali_token', access_token) + localStorage.setItem('sawali_user', JSON.stringify(user)) then navigate. WelcomeBriefing modal ([data-testid=welcome-briefing]) needs to be removed/dismissed before clicking admin buttons. To validate ContactGroupChips inside WhatsAppModal/SmsModal UI: need an existing contact with a phone number; current /portal/contacts route lands on the Messaging Center 'unknown-contacts' tab which only shows Import/Ignore. Switch to the 'Tous' tab or seed 1 imported contact + 1 contact group to fully validate the chip click flow.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in scope. Feature 1 (Saturday-noon rotation toggle) is fully working end-to-end. Feature 2 (ContactGroupChips) is fully implemented per code (imports, insertion in both modals at lines 1236 + 3041, userRole prop wiring, red-ring styling, role gating with 'lecture seule' fallback). The chip click flow was not exercised live due to trigger-button availability on the chosen entry path; backend endpoints used by the chips (/me/contact-groups POST/DELETE) were already covered by previous pytest iterations.
